evidence.note: Trade report: 30-inch mainline about 105 mi from Ewing Bank 873 to Larose gas plant; system 150 mi.

candidates.name: Decatur Lateral (Midcoast to Calpine Decatur and Morgan Energy Centers)

evidence.note: Midcoast to supply Calpine plants near Decatur AL; about 52-mile pipeline; service planned summer 2002.

candidates.why_maybe_new: No roster row for Midcoast Alabama lateral; about 50 to 52 mi (80 to 84 km). Diameter 30 in is EIA only.

candidates.name: Egan Hub Storage Header Expansion (Line 73 loop)
candidates.to: Texas Gas Transmission M&R station, Evangeline Parish LA

evidence.note: CP07-88: 16.5-mile 24-inch header loop; remaining 8.5 mi placed in service.

candidates.why_maybe_new: 16.5 mi = 26.6 km, just over the floor; but the 16.5 mi may be the whole header system with only 8.5 mi new. Borderline, length of new pipe needs the FERC order.

candidates.name: Cheniere Southern Trail Pipeline
candidates.to: FGT Station 12, Santa Rosa County, FL (as proposed)

evidence.note: Open season for Southern Trail, proposed about 348 mi up to 42-inch, Eunice LA to FGT Station 12.

candidates.why_maybe_new: EIA says completed 2008 at 135 mi, but sources show a proposed 348 mi line; Creole Trail (P0283) was the part built. Likely never built; cancelled-project candidate, status needs FERC docket check.
